# WordPress

The Froala plugin for WordPress puts the editor in the admin in place of the classic editor, and lets your theme start it on the front end. Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/froala/wordpress-froala-wysiwyg).

## Compatibility

The README gives WordPress 3.3.0 and later.

In the admin, the plugin takes over the editor that [`wp_editor()`](https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/hooks/wp_editor_settings/) draws, which is the classic editor. Posts that open in the block editor keep the block editor.

## Installation

The plugin isn't in the WordPress.org plugin directory, so searching for it under Plugins finds nothing. Install it from GitHub.

1. Download the plugin as a [ZIP from GitHub](https://github.com/froala/wordpress-froala-wysiwyg/archive/master.zip).
2. In the admin, go to Plugins, then Add New Plugin, then Upload Plugin, and upload the ZIP. Or unpack it into a new folder in `wp-content/plugins`.
3. Activate the plugin on the Plugins page.

The plugin's settings page takes your license key and turns each of the editor's plugins on or off. Both apply in the admin and on the front end.

## In the Admin

Once active, the plugin starts the editor on the classic editor's `#content` field, with your license key and the plugins you turned on. Images upload to the Media Library, and the image manager lists the images there.

## On the Front End

To show the editor on your site, create a `Froala_Editor` in your theme and call `activate` with a selector. A second argument, an array or an object, passes any of the editor's [options](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/). The plugin adds your license key from its settings.

### Simple Start

```php
$froala = new Froala_Editor();
$froala->activate('#comment');
```

### With Options

```php
$froala = new Froala_Editor();
$froala->activate('#comment', array(
    'colorsBackground' => ['#61BD6D', '#1ABC9C', '#54ACD2', 'REMOVE'],
    'colorsText'       => ['#61BD6D', '#1ABC9C', '#54ACD2', 'REMOVE']
));
```

### Images in the Media Library

Point the upload and image manager at `admin-ajax.php` with the plugin's two actions.

```php
$froala = new Froala_Editor();
$froala->activate('#comment', array(
    'imageUploadURL'         => admin_url('admin-ajax.php'),
    'imageUploadParams'      => ['action' => 'froala_upload_files'],
    'imageManagerLoadURL'    => admin_url('admin-ajax.php'),
    'imageManagerLoadParams' => ['action' => 'froala_image_manager']
));
```

Both actions also answer visitors who aren't logged in, and neither checks a nonce or a capability. Anyone can add files to your Media Library through them and list its images, whether or not a page uses the editor. Weigh that before you activate the plugin on a public site.

## Hooks and Constants

### Constants

The plugin defines two paths for your own files, under its `custom` folder.

```php
FroalaEditorCustomJSFolderPath   // '/<plugin folder>/custom/js'
FroalaEditorCustomCSSFolderPath  // '/<plugin folder>/custom/css'
```

### Hooks

Each hook adds a script or a stylesheet, as a file or inline, before or after the editor starts.

| Hook | Where | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `froala_before_public_init` | Front end | Before the editor starts |
| `froala_after_public_init` | Front end | After the editor and its plugins load |
| `froala_before_init` | Admin | Before the editor starts |
| `froala_after_init` | Admin | After the editor and its plugins load |

Every hook takes the same four arguments and returns an array, or a `WP_Error` that says what is wrong.

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `$path` | The file's URL, or `null` for inline code. |
| `$type` | `'js'` or `'css'`. |
| `$prop` | `'file'` or `'inline'`. |
| `$mix` | The file's name for a file, or the code itself for inline. |

Apply a hook after you create the `Froala_Editor` and before you call `activate`, and keep its result to see any error.

```php
$froala = new Froala_Editor();
$custom_css_path = plugins_url(FroalaEditorCustomCSSFolderPath);
$custom_js_path  = plugins_url(FroalaEditorCustomJSFolderPath);

// A stylesheet file after the editor starts, at the end of the head.
$hook = apply_filters('froala_after_public_init', $custom_css_path . '/test.css', 'css', 'file', 'test');

// A script file before the editor starts.
$hook = apply_filters('froala_before_public_init', $custom_js_path . '/test.js', 'js', 'file', 'test');

// Inline code.
$hook = apply_filters('froala_after_public_init', null, 'js', 'inline', 'console.log("test")');
$hook = apply_filters('froala_before_public_init', null, 'css', 'inline', 'h1 { background-color: #00ffff; }');

if (is_wp_error($hook)) {
    echo $hook->get_error_message();
}

$froala->activate('#comment');
```

In the admin, use `froala_before_init` and `froala_after_init` the same way.

## Add a Custom Plugin

`froala_new_plugin` adds your own editor plugin to the list on the settings page, from its file's URL and a name. Add the code to `froala.php`, then turn the plugin on in the settings.

```php
$custom_plugin_path = plugins_url(FroalaEditorCustomJSFolderPath);
$new_plugin = apply_filters('froala_new_plugin', $custom_plugin_path . '/test.js', 'test');

if (is_wp_error($new_plugin)) {
    echo $new_plugin->get_error_message();
}
```

To try a plugin on the front end without the settings page, load it with `froala_before_public_init` from your theme's `functions.php`. The plugin ships a sample at `custom/js/test.js` that you can delete.

```php
$custom_plugin_path = plugins_url(FroalaEditorCustomJSFolderPath);
$new_plugin = apply_filters('froala_before_public_init', $custom_plugin_path . '/test.js', 'js', 'file', 'test');
```

[Custom Plugin](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/concepts/custom/plugin/)

## Additional Resources

- [The Froala editor in WordPress](https://froala.com/blog/general/powerful-wysiwyg-froala-html-editor-into-wordpress/)
- [The plugin's README](https://github.com/froala/wordpress-froala-wysiwyg#readme)

### aiAssist.requestAnswer (params, signal)

Returns: Promise<Object>

Sends a single buffered request to the configured AI backend and resolves with `{ answer, session_id?, webSearchUsed? }`. As of 5.4.0, `params` accepts five additional optional fields, and existing callers that omit them see unchanged behavior. As of 5.5.0, `params` accept `regenerate` (Boolean). When it's `true`, it's passed to `aiAssistRequest` as `data.regenerate`, or sent in the `aiAssistEndpoint` request body, so a caching backend returns a new answer for the same prompt.

-   **params**
    
    Type: Object
    
    The request payload, including the existing `prompt` field plus the optional `webSearchEnabled` (Boolean), `model` (String), `reasoningEnabled` (Boolean), `files` (Array), `referenceUrls` (Array of Strings) fields, and `regenerate` (Boolean).
    
-   **signal**
    
    Type: AbortSignal
    
    Used to cancel an in-flight request.
    

#### CODE EXAMPLES

Invoke the method inside the rich text editor:

```
const editor = new FroalaEditor('#editor');

const answer = await editor.aiAssist.requestAnswer({
  prompt: 'Write a tagline for a coffee shop',
  webSearchEnabled: true,
  model: 'gpt-4o',
  referenceUrls: ['https://example.com/article'],
  regenerate: true
});
```

### aiAssist.requestAnswerStream (params, onChunk, signal)

Returns: Promise<Object>

Streaming sibling of `requestAnswer`, takes the same `params` shape (including the five new fields above) plus an `onChunk` callback that receives raw text deltas as they arrive.

-   **params**
    
    Type: Object
    
    Same shape as `requestAnswer`'s params.
    
-   **onChunk**
    
    Type: Function
    
    Called with each decoded text chunk as it streams in.
    
-   **signal**
    
    Type: AbortSignal
    
    Used to cancel an in-flight request.
    

**Returns:** `Promise<{ answer: string, session_id?: string, webSearchUsed?: boolean }>` — same shape and same rules as `requestAnswer`'s return value above; note that the built-in `aiAssistEndpoint` path only reports `session_id`/`webSearchUsed` for `requestAnswer`, not for the streaming path — only a custom `aiAssistRequest` handler can report them while streaming.

**Note:** A custom `aiAssistRequest` handler that wants to support AI Chat streaming needs to accept and call an optional 3rd argument, `onChunk` — beyond the existing 2-argument contract `requestAnswer` uses. Existing non-streaming integrations are unaffected.

#### CODE EXAMPLES

Invoke the method inside the rich text editor:

```
var editor = new FroalaEditor('.selector', {}, function () {
  // Call the method inside the initialized event.
  editor.aiAssist.requestAnswerStream(
    { prompt: 'Write a paragraph about the ocean' },
    (chunk) => { console.log('chunk:', chunk); },
    signal
  );
})
```

### aiChatAssistant.getChatHistory ()

Returns: Array

Returns the complete AI Chat conversation so far, oldest turn first, as plain serializable records. The result is a snapshot rather than a live view, so mutating it has no effect on the panel, and an empty array is returned when there are no messages yet. Each record exposes `id`, `role`, `text`, `createdAt`, `contextText`, `contextKind`, `webSearchUsed`, `applied`, `error`, and `streaming`.

Field

Type

Description

**id**

String

Stable per-message id, also the transcript element's `data-id`.

**role**

'user' | 'assistant'

Who produced the turn.

**text**

String

The message text. For an assistant turn this is the provider's answer as received, before the panel's own fence-stripping and sanitizing for display.

**createdAt**

Number | null

`Date.now()` at the moment the turn was created.

**contextText**

String

What the turn was grounded in, meaning the resolved context sent with the request (document or selection HTML, file text, reference URLs, or the previous response's preview). Empty string when the turn had no context.

**contextKind**

'document' | 'selection' | null

Which in-document source the context came from, or `null` for a chat-only turn or one grounded only in a file or URL.

**webSearchUsed**

Boolean

Whether the backend confirmed it used web search for this answer.

**applied**

Boolean

Whether this answer has been applied to the document.

**error**

Boolean

Whether the turn failed, which renders as the inline error bubble.

**streaming**

Boolean

Whether the answer is still streaming in.

Note: the returned records deliberately do not expose the message's internal `contextRange`, which is a live DOM Range into the editor's own content and is neither serializable nor safe to hand out.

#### CODE EXAMPLES

Invoke the method inside the rich text editor:

```
var editor = new FroalaEditor('.selector', {}, function () {
  // Call the method inside the initialized event.
  const history = editor.aiChatAssistant.getChatHistory();
  // [
  //   { id: 'fr-ai-chat-msg-1', role: 'user',      text: 'Summarize chapter 2', … },
  //   { id: 'fr-ai-chat-msg-2', role: 'assistant', text: '<p>Chapter 2 argues…</p>', … }
  // ]
})
```

### aiImproveWriting.applyExternalRewriteDirect (range, originalText, answer)

Returns: Boolean

Applies an externally-generated rewrite (e.g. from AI Chat's "Apply to document") using the same word-diff/review logic as Improve Writing itself, for a caller whose own UI already served as the review/confirmation step. When collaborating, it applies the change immediately instead of opening a review popup, a direct edit in "editing" mode, or a tracked suggestion per hunk in "suggesting" mode. This is the only public entry point for applying an externally-sourced rewrite.

-   **range**
    
    Type: Range
    
    A live DOM Range pointing at the exact region of the editor's content that `answer` is meant to replace. This is not something you construct from scratch, it should be the same Range you captured before sending the request to your AI backend (e.g. `editor.selection.get().getRangeAt(0)` for the user's current selection, or a Range spanning the whole editable body when no selection was active). The method re-reads this Range's live text at call time and compares it against `originalText`: if the document changed underneath it in the meantime (the user kept typing while the AI request was in flight), the call fails safely (see Returns above) instead of corrupting unrelated content.
    
-   **originalText**
    
    Type: String
    
    The plain text that `range` contained at the moment you sent the request, a snapshot, not a live read. Pass whatever you read from the editor right before calling your AI backend (e.g. `editor.html.getSelected()`/`range.toString()`), unmodified. The method uses this both to validate the range hasn't gone stale (see above) and as the "before" side of the word-level diff shown to reviewers.
    
-   **answer**
    
    Type: String
    
    The candidate/rewritten text returned by the AI backend, the "after" side of the diff. Plain text or lightly-marked text is expected; any HTML/fencing wrapping the model may have added is stripped internally before diffing.
    

**Returns:**

-   `true`: the rewrite was applied (directly, or as a review flow was started/a tracked suggestion inserted, depending on collaboration mode).
-   `false`:no-op. Either the caller was busy (an Improve Writing session, a collab review, or another AI request was already active), or `range`'s current live text no longer equals `originalText` (the document changed since it was captured) — in both cases nothing is applied, so it's safe to show your own "please try again" message.

#### CODE EXAMPLES

Invoke the method inside the rich text editor:

```
const editor = new FroalaEditor('#editor');

async function rewriteSelectionWithAI(prompt) {
  // 1. Capture the Range and its text BEFORE the async AI call — this is
  //    exactly the pair applyExternalRewriteDirect will validate against.
  const range = editor.selection.get().getRangeAt(0);
  const originalText = range.toString();

  // 2. Send the request to your configured AI backend (reuses the same
  //    request layer AI Chat/Improve Writing use).
  const { answer } = await editor.aiAssist.requestAnswer({
    prompt: `${prompt}\n\n"""${originalText}"""`
  }, new AbortController().signal);

  // 3. Apply the result back into the document using the *same* range/text
  //    pair captured in step 1 — not a freshly re-read selection, since the
  //    user may have clicked elsewhere while the request was in flight.
  const applied = editor.aiImproveWriting.applyExternalRewriteDirect(
    range,
    originalText,
    answer
  );

  if (!applied) {
    // Busy, or the selection changed while waiting for the response.
    console.warn('Could not apply the rewrite — please try again.');
  }
}
```

### toast.show(opts)

Creates and displays a toast notification.  
  
**Parameters:**

-   **opts**
    
    Type: Object
    
    Configuration object. All keys are optional.
    

**opts properties**

Property

Type

Default

Description

`title`

String

—

Short headline text rendered in <span class="fr-toast\_\_title">. Automatically HTML-escaped.

`description`

String

—

Supporting body text rendered in <span class="fr-toast\_\_description">. Automatically HTML-escaped.

`html`

String

—

Raw HTML string injected as the entire toast body. When provided, title and description are ignored. Not escaped — caller is responsible for sanitizing.

`type`

String

"default"

Visual variant. One of: "default", "success", "error", "warning", "gray". Appends a fr-toast--<type> modifier class.

`size`

String

"default"

Size variant. One of: "default", "small". Appends a fr-toast--<size> modifier class.

`position`

String

"lt-bt"

Screen position code. See Position Codes table below. Falls back to "lt-bt" for unrecognized values.

`showIn`

String | Element

—

CSS selector string or DOM element that acts as the toast container's parent. Defaults to the editor wrapper element (editor.$wp\[0\]), or document.body if the wrapper is unavailable.

`interval`

Number | false

5000

Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds. Set to false to keep the toast visible until manually dismissed. Set to 0 to dismiss immediately after rendering.

`undoFn`

Function

—

When provided, an Undo button is appended to the toast. Clicking it invokes this callback, then dismisses the toast. Errors thrown by the callback are silently swallowed.

`hideClose`

Boolean

false

When true, the close (×) button is omitted from the toast.

  

**Returns:**

-   `{ hide: Function }` — when `interval` is `false`. Calling `hide()` removes the toast from the DOM immediately.
    
-   `undefined` — for all auto-dismissing toasts.
    

```
// Auto-dismissing toast (disappears after 5 s by default)
editor.toast.show({
  title: 'Comment added',
  type: 'success'
});

// Persistent toast — must be dismissed manually
const handle = editor.toast.show({
  title: 'Connecting…',
  description: 'Waiting for the collaboration server.',
  interval: false
});
// Later, when the connection is established:
handle.hide();

// Toast with undo button
editor.toast.show({
  title: 'Suggestion accepted',
  undoFn: () => editor.collaborative.setMode('suggesting'),
  interval: 8000
});

// Custom HTML body
editor.toast.show({
  html: '<strong>Version saved:</strong> Draft v2',
  type: 'success',
  position: 'ct-bt'
});

// Small warning at the top-right, no close button
editor.toast.show({
  title: 'Read-only mode',
  type: 'warning',
  size: 'small',
  position: 'rt-tp',
  hideClose: true
});
```

**Position Codes**  
  
Toasts are positioned using a two-segment code: <horizontal>-<vertical>.

Segment

Value

Meaning

### helpers.ensureHeadlessFocus ()

Returns: void

In headless mode, focuses the editor if the current selection isn't inside it, so the browser drops a caret into the content. A toolbar click normally does this for you, and in headless mode there's no toolbar. Call it at the start of an action method that reads the selection. Outside headless mode it does nothing.

#### CODE EXAMPLES

Invoke the method inside the rich text editor:

```
FroalaEditor.PLUGINS.myHighlighter = function (editor) {
  function apply() {
    editor.helpers.ensureHeadlessFocus();
    editor.format.applyStyle('background-color', 'yellow');
  }
  return { apply: apply };
};
```

### helpers.guardHeadlessUI (pluginApi, methodNames)

Returns: Boolean

For plugins that open their own UI outside the popups and modals system. In headless mode it replaces each named method on `pluginApi` with one that does nothing and returns `false`, and returns `true` so you can skip building UI that will never be shown. Outside headless mode it changes nothing and returns `false`.

-   **pluginApi**
    
    Type: Object
    
    The object your plugin returns.
    
-   **methodNames**
    
    Type: String\[\]
    
    The methods to turn off.
    

#### CODE EXAMPLES

Invoke the method inside the rich text editor:

```
FroalaEditor.PLUGINS.myPicker = function (editor) {
  function open() {
    const dialog = document.createElement('dialog');
    dialog.textContent = 'Pick an item';
    document.body.appendChild(dialog);
    dialog.showModal();
  }
  const api = { open: open };
  editor.helpers.guardHeadlessUI(api, ['open']);
  return api;
};
```

Returns: void

In headless mode, sets the option `key` to `value` unless you already set that option explicitly. Outside headless mode it does nothing. Returns nothing.

### markdown.setMarkdown (markdown)

Returns: Boolean | null

Replaces the Markdown editor’s content with a given Markdown string. Fires `markdown.beforeSet` before applying (return false from a listener to cancel), and `markdown.set` once applied.

pages.markdown:
# Migrate from V3 to V5

Version 5 keeps the version 3 API. No option, plugin or documented method of 3.2.7 was removed, so upgrading is a new package, a new license key, a look at the defaults that changed and, for Vue, a move to Vue 3.

Version 5 needs a new license key. Ask [support@froala.com](mailto:support@froala.com) for yours.

## Install Version 5

Update the editor and your framework's wrapper together. Each wrapper depends on the exact editor version it was released with.

**React**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5 react-froala-wysiwyg@5
```

[React guide](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/react/)

**Vue**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5 vue-froala-wysiwyg@5
```

[Vue guide](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/vue-js-3/)

**Angular**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5 angular-froala-wysiwyg@5
```

[Angular guide](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/angular/)

**JavaScript**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5
```

[Installation](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/overview/)

From the CDN, point your tags at version 5.

```html
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@5/css/froala_editor.pkgd.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@5/js/froala_editor.pkgd.min.js"></script>
```

No editor file of the 3.2.7 package was renamed or removed in 5.5.0, so your script and stylesheet paths stay the same.

`froala_editor.pkgd.min.js` grew from 0.9 MB in 3.2.7 to 2.0 MB in 5.5.0 (257 KB to 549 KB gzipped), mostly from the plugins added since. To load less, use `froala_editor.min.js` and only the [plugins](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/) you need.

## Add Your License Key

The editor starts the same way in both versions. Keep your options and events, and put the version 5 key in `key`.

```js
new FroalaEditor('#editor', {
  key: 'YOUR_V5_LICENSE_KEY',

  // Your version 3 options, unchanged.
  toolbarButtons: [['bold', 'italic', 'underline'], ['insertLink', 'insertImage']],

  events: {
    contentChanged: function () {
      // Inside a handler, this is the editor.
      console.log(this.html.get());
    }
  }
});
```

[Activation](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/activation/)

## Changed Defaults

These defaults changed after 3.2.7. Check each one against your setup; an option you set yourself keeps your value.

| Option | Since | What changed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`fontSize`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSize) | 5.3.0 | The list ends with `'custom'`, which lets users type a size between `fontSizeCustomMin` and `fontSizeCustomMax`. |
| [`tableDefaultWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultWidth) | 4.6.0 | From `'100%'` to `'50%'`, so a new table fills half the width. |
| [`tableEditButtons`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableEditButtons) | 4.6.0 | `tableProperties` and `tableCellProperties` replace `tableStyle` and `tableCellBackground`. Since 4.0.19 the list also has `tableFooter`. |
| `imageInsertButtons`, `videoInsertButtons`, `fileInsertButtons`, `filesInsertButtons` | 4.3.0 | With the Filestack plugin loaded, as it is in `froala_editor.pkgd.min.js`, each insert popup shows a Filestack picker button. Set `pluginsDisabled: ['filestack']` to leave it out. |
| [`fontSizeDefaultSelection`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSizeDefaultSelection), [`fontFamilyDefaultSelection`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontFamilyDefaultSelection) | 4.2.1 | Set to a size or a font, the value is also applied to the content, not only shown in the dropdown. The size's default went from `'12'` to `'Font Size'`, which applies nothing. |

The commands `tableCellBackgroundColor` and `tableCellBackgroundCustomColor` are gone since 4.6.0. `tableCellBackground` left with them and is back as a command since 5.0.0, outside the default list.

### Framework Wrappers

| Wrapper | What changed |
| --- | --- |
| `vue-froala-wysiwyg` | Needs Vue 3.2 or later since 4.1.0; the version 3 wrapper used Vue 2. Register it with `app.use(VueFroala)` and bind the content with `v-model:value`. |
| `react-froala-wysiwyg` | Works with React 0.14 to 19. React 18 came in 4.0.14 and React 19 in 4.6.0; the version 3 wrapper stopped at React 16. |
| `angular-froala-wysiwyg` | Built for Angular 19 and later. Import its modules into a standalone component. |

## New Plugins

Versions 4 and 5 add these plugins. All but Track Changes and Image Filerobot are in `froala_editor.pkgd.min.js`; to load them one by one, add each one's script and stylesheet.

| Plugin | Since | What it does | Name |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Collaborative](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/collaborative-plugin/) | 5.3.0 | Real-time editing, comments, suggestions and version history. | `collaborative` |
| [Image Filerobot](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/filerobot-image-editor-plugin/) | 5.2.0 | Edits images in Filerobot Image Editor. A third-party plugin in `js/third_party/imageFileRobot.min.js`, which needs the Filerobot library. | `imageFilerobot` |
| [AI Assist](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/ai-assist-plugin/) | 5.1.0 | AI writing and editing tools through the AI provider you connect. Needs `aiSupplementalTermsAccepted: true`. | `aiAssist` |
| [Code Snippet](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/code-snippet-plugin/) | 5.0.0 | Inserts code blocks with syntax highlighting. Needs Prism.js on the page. | `codeSnippet` |
| [Import from Word](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/import-from-word-plugin/) | 5.0.0 | Imports a Word (.docx) file, converted in the browser with Mammoth.js or on your server. | `importFromWord` |
| [Anchor](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/link-to-anchor-plugin/) | 4.7.0 | Adds named anchors and links to them. | `linkToAnchor` |
| [Page Break](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/page-break-plugin/) | 4.7.0 | Inserts, moves and shows page breaks. | `pageBreak` |
| [Export to Word](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/export-to-word-plugin/) | 4.7.0 | Exports the content to a Word (.docx) file. Needs the html-docx-js and FileSaver libraries. | `exportToWord` |
| [Find and Replace](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/find-replace-plugin/) | 4.5.2 | Finds text in the content and replaces it. In the packaged file since 4.6.0. | `findReplace` |
| [Filestack](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/filestack-plugin/) | 4.3.0 | Uploads files through Filestack, with its file and image transformations. Needs a Filestack API key. | `filestack` |
| [Word Counter](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/word-counter-plugin/) | 4.2.0 | Counts words in the bottom bar, and can cap them with `wordCounterMax`. | `wordCounter` |
| [Markdown](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/markdown-plugin/) | 4.0.0 | Writes the content in Markdown syntax, with a split view of the result. | `markdown` |
| [Track Changes](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/track-changes-plugin/) | 4.0.0 | Tracks added and deleted content and formatting, so each change can be accepted or rejected. Load `js/plugins/track_changes.min.js` on its own. | `track_changes` |

If you set `pluginsEnabled`, add the names of the new plugins you want to it.

```js
new FroalaEditor('#editor', {
  pluginsEnabled: ['image', 'link', 'table', 'wordCounter', 'findReplace', 'exportToWord', 'codeSnippet']
});
```

[Plugins](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/)

## New Options

Besides each new plugin's own options, these options were added or changed. Changed ones are marked.

| Option | Since | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`headless`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#headless) | 5.5.0 | Runs the editor without its toolbar, popups or other UI, so you build your own controls on its API. |
| [`preserveListMarkerStyle`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#preserveListMarkerStyle) | 5.5.0 | Where bold or italic on a whole list item goes. `true`, the default, styles the `li` and its marker; `false` wraps the text in `strong` or `em`. |
| [`collabConfig.panel.defaultState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#collabConfig.panel.defaultState) | 5.5.0 | The state the collaboration side panel opens in, `'expanded'` (the default), `'collapsed'` or `'hidden'`. |
| [`aiChatModels`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatModels) | 5.5.0, changed | A model that declares `webSearch: false` or `reasoning: false` turns off the matching AI Chat toggle. |
| [`aiChatWebSearchEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatWebSearchEnabled), [`aiChatReasoningEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatReasoningEnabled) | 5.5.0, changed | The toggle's starting state is now a request. It stays off for a model that declares the feature `false`. |
| [`aiAssistRequest`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiAssistRequest) | 5.5.0, changed | Your handler receives `regenerate: true` when the user clicks Try again, so a caching backend can send a fresh answer. Since 5.4.0 it can stream through a third argument, `onChunk`, and report `webSearchUsed`. |
| [`aiChatModels`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatModels), [`aiChatDefaultModel`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatDefaultModel) | 5.4.0 | The models users pick from in the AI Chat panel, and the one selected when it opens. |
| [`aiChatWebSearchEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatWebSearchEnabled), [`aiChatReasoningEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatReasoningEnabled) | 5.4.0 | Whether the web search and reasoning toggles start on. |
| [`aiChatStreamResponse`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatStreamResponse) | 5.4.0 | Streams AI Chat answers, or waits for the whole answer. |
| [`aiChatSupportedFileTypes`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatSupportedFileTypes), [`aiChatMaxFileSizeMB`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatMaxFileSizeMB), [`aiChatMaxFiles`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatMaxFiles) | 5.4.0 | Which files users can attach as context, how large, and how many. |
| [`aiChatRequestTimeoutMs`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatRequestTimeoutMs), [`aiChatIncludeReferenceUrlsInContext`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatIncludeReferenceUrlsInContext) | 5.4.0 | How long to wait for an answer, in milliseconds, and whether reference URLs are also added to the prompt text. |
| [`aiChatPanelWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatPanelWidth), [`aiChatPanelMaxWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatPanelMaxWidth), [`aiChatWelcomeMessage`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatWelcomeMessage) | 5.4.0 | The panel's starting and largest width, in pixels, and the intro text of the empty panel. |
| [`aiImproveWritingPrompt`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiImproveWritingPrompt) | 5.4.0 | The instruction sent each time Improve Writing runs. |
| [`selectionActionButtons`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#selectionActionButtons) | 5.4.0 | The buttons of the popup that opens on a text selection. |
| [`inlineSuggestions`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#inlineSuggestions), [`inlineSuggestionsDelay`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#inlineSuggestionsDelay), [`inlineSuggestionsPromptTemplate`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#inlineSuggestionsPromptTemplate) | 5.4.0 | Suggested text that continues what the user types, the wait before it is requested, and its prompt. |
| [`aiSpeechToText`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToText), [`aiSpeechToTextWaveform`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToTextWaveform), [`aiSpeechToTextListeningText`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToTextListeningText), [`aiSpeechToTextMaxDuration`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToTextMaxDuration) | 5.4.0 | A microphone button to dictate the AI prompt, its waveform and label, and the longest recording, in seconds. |
| [`fontSizeCustomMin`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSizeCustomMin), [`fontSizeCustomMax`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSizeCustomMax) | 5.3.0 | The smallest and largest size users can type in the custom font size box. |
| [`importFromWordMammoth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#importFromWordMammoth) | 5.3.0 | The Mammoth instance Import from Word uses, for module builds such as Vite. |
| [`preserveListLineOnBackspace`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#preserveListLineOnBackspace) | 5.2.0 | Backspace at the start of a list item removes only its marker. |
| [`toolbarButtonsEnabledOnEditorOff`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#toolbarButtonsEnabledOnEditorOff) | 5.0.1 | The buttons that stay active after `edit.off()`, for a partly read-only editor. |
| [`tableHorizontalResizer`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableHorizontalResizer), [`tableVerticalResizer`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableVerticalResizer) | 5.0.1 | Turn horizontal and vertical table resizing on or off. |
| [`retainLineBreaksInCellsOnWrap`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#retainLineBreaksInCellsOnWrap) | 5.0.0 | Keeps the line breaks in a table cell when its content wraps. |
| [`clearFormatOnEnterNewLine`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#clearFormatOnEnterNewLine) | 4.7.1 | Starts the line after pasted content without its formatting. |
| [`cleanReduntantStyleOnGet`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#cleanReduntantStyleOnGet) | 4.7.1 | Removes styles that repeat a parent's from what `html.get()` returns. |
| [`proportionalTableResize`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#proportionalTableResize) | 4.6.2 | How a table behaves when you resize it. |
| [`enableTableSelection`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#enableTableSelection) | 4.6.2 | Turns table selection on or off. |
| [`tableDefaultAlign`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultAlign), [`tableDefaultHeight`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultHeight), [`tableDefaultBGColor`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultBGColor) | 4.6.0 | The alignment, height and background color of a new table. |
| [`tableDefaultBorderColor`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultBorderColor), [`tableDefaultBorderWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultBorderWidth), [`tableDefaultBorderStyle`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultBorderStyle) | 4.6.0 | The border color, width and style of a new table. Width and style default to `''` since 5.0.0, after `'1px'` and `'solid'`. |
| [`allowStylingOnNonEditable`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#allowStylingOnNonEditable) | 4.5.1 | Allows styling `contenteditable="false"` elements. |
| [`pluginsDisabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#pluginsDisabled) | 4.5.0 | The plugins to turn off in this editor. |
| [`lineHeights`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#lineHeights) | 4.5.0, changed | Also takes a list of `{ label, value }` objects, which keeps your order. An object puts whole-number keys such as `'2'` first. |
| [`preserveTabSpaces`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#preservetabspaces) | 4.2.1 | Turns tab characters in the content into spaces, as many as `tabSpaces` sets or 4, instead of dropping them. |
| [`toolbarResponsiveToEditor`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#toolbarresponsivetoeditor) | 4.1.0 | Sizes the toolbar to the editor's width instead of the window's. |

`tableResizer`, `tableResizerOffset`, `tableResizingLimit`, `tabSpaces`, `fontFamilyDefaultSelection` and `fontSizeDefaultSelection` were already in 3.2.7. Only the last two changed, as [Changed Defaults](#changed-defaults) shows.

The Since column on this page comes from comparing the packaged file of every release on npm, from 3.2.7 to 5.5.0.

[All options](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/)

## New Methods

Besides each new plugin's own methods, these methods were added or changed. Call them on the editor once it has started.

| Method | Since | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`helpers.isHeadless`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.isHeadless), [`helpers.isUserOpt`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.isUserOpt) | 5.5.0 | Whether the editor runs in headless mode, and whether you set an option yourself. |
| [`helpers.headlessDefault`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.headlessDefault), [`helpers.guardHeadlessUI`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.guardHeadlessUI), [`helpers.ensureHeadlessFocus`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.ensureHeadlessFocus) | 5.5.0 | In headless mode, set an option unless you set it, turn a plugin's own UI methods into ones that do nothing, and put the caret in the content. |
| [`collaborative.getPanelState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.getPanelState), [`collaborative.setPanelState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.setPanelState) | 5.5.0 | Read and set the collaboration side panel's state, `'expanded'`, `'collapsed'` or `'hidden'`. They belong to the Collaborative plugin, not to `helpers`. |
| [`collaborative.updatePanelState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.updatePanelState) | 5.5.0, changed | Expands or collapses the side panel. Added in 5.3.0. |
| `image.insertByURL` | 5.5.0, changed | Inserts the image from the URL in the insert popup. An older method; the change is not described on the Methods page. |
| [`aiAssist.requestAnswer`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiAssist.requestAnswer), [`aiAssist.requestAnswerStream`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiAssist.requestAnswerStream) | 5.4.0 | Send one request to your AI backend, and get the whole answer or a stream. `requestAnswer` takes more optional fields since 5.5.0. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.togglePanel`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.togglePanel), [`aiChatAssistant.isPanelOpen`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.isPanelOpen), [`aiChatAssistant.sendMessage`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.sendMessage) | 5.4.0 | Open or close the AI Chat panel, check whether it is open, and send a prompt. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.addContextSource`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.addContextSource), [`aiChatAssistant.removeContextSource`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.removeContextSource) | 5.4.0 | Add and remove a context source of the conversation. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.hasActiveConversation`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.hasActiveConversation), [`aiChatAssistant.getChatHistory`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.getChatHistory), [`aiChatAssistant.applyToEditor`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.applyToEditor) | 5.4.0 | Whether a conversation is open, the conversation so far, and put an answer into the document. |
| [`aiImproveWriting.start`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.start), [`aiImproveWriting.applyExternalRewriteDirect`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.applyExternalRewriteDirect) | 5.4.0 | Send the selection to the AI for review, and apply a rewrite made elsewhere with the same review. |
| [`aiImproveWriting.hasActiveSession`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.hasActiveSession), [`aiImproveWriting.hasActiveCollabReview`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.hasActiveCollabReview), [`aiImproveWriting.isInFlight`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.isInFlight) | 5.4.0 | Whether a review or a collaborative review is open, and whether a request is waiting for its answer. |
| [`aiImproveWriting.acceptAllSession`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.acceptAllSession), [`aiImproveWriting.rejectAllSession`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.rejectAllSession) | 5.4.0 | Accept or reject every change of the open review. |
| [`collaborative.isPanelOpen`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.isPanelOpen), [`collaborative.hidePanelForCoexistence`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.hidePanelForCoexistence) | 5.4.0 | Whether the comments panel is open, and hide it so another side panel can open. |
| [`dockPanel.registerCoexistence`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#dockPanel.registerCoexistence), [`dockPanel.unregisterCoexistence`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#dockPanel.unregisterCoexistence) | 5.4.0 | Register your own side panel so only one side panel is open at a time, and remove it again. |
| [`markdown.getMarkdown`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#markdown.getMarkdown), [`markdown.setMarkdown`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#markdown.setMarkdown) | 5.4.0 | Read and replace the content as Markdown. |
| [`selection.element`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#selection.element) | 5.4.0, changed | Returns the element at the selection. An older method, which now takes an optional `skipCaptionNormalization` argument. |
| [`toast.show`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#toast.show) | 5.3.0 | Shows a toast notification. |
| [`table.showTableProperties`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#table.showTableProperties), [`table.hideTableProperties`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#table.hideTableProperties) | 4.6.0 | Open and close the table properties popup. |
| [`table.showCellPropertiesPopup`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#table.showCellPropertiesPopup) | 4.6.0 | Opens the cell properties popup. |
| [`html.wrap`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#html.wrap) | 4.1.0, fixed | Wraps text into paragraphs. 4.1.0 stopped it leaving empty paragraphs when you merge cells of a wrapped table. |

[All methods](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/)

## New Events

Besides each new plugin's own events, these events were added or changed.

| Event | Since | When it fires |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`image.resizeStart`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#image.resizeStart) | 5.5.0 | The user grabs an image resize handle, before the size changes. |
| [`video.resizeStart`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#video.resizeStart), [`video.resizeEnd`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#video.resizeEnd) | 5.5.0 | The user grabs a video resize handle, and releases it with the new size applied. |
| [`collab.panelStateChanged`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#collab.panelStateChanged) | 5.5.0 | The collaboration side panel changes state. Passes the new state, the previous one and what caused it. |
| [`image.replaced`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#image.replaced) | 5.5.0, changed | Also passes the replaced image's `src`, as a third argument, `old_src`. |
| [`video.replaced`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#video.replaced) | 5.5.0, changed | Passes the upload response and the replaced video's `old_src`, for uploads and URLs alike. |
| [`markdown.beforeGet`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.beforeGet), [`markdown.afterGet`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.afterGet), [`markdown.beforeSet`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.beforeSet), [`markdown.set`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.set) | 5.4.0 | Before and after the content is read or set as Markdown. Returning `false` from a before event cancels it. |
| [`aiAssist.chatPanelResized`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.chatPanelResized) | 5.4.0 | The user finishes resizing the AI Chat panel. |
| [`aiAssist.chatBeforeApply`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.chatBeforeApply), [`aiAssist.chatAfterApply`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.chatAfterApply) | 5.4.0 | Before and after a chat answer goes into the document. Returning `false` from the first cancels it. |
| [`aiAssist.improveWritingStarted`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.improveWritingStarted), [`aiAssist.improveWritingResponse`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.improveWritingResponse) | 5.4.0 | An Improve Writing request is sent, and its answer arrives. |
| [`aiAssist.reviewStarted`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.reviewStarted), [`aiAssist.hunkResolved`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.hunkResolved), [`aiAssist.reviewEnded`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.reviewEnded) | 5.4.0 | A review of AI changes opens, one of its changes is accepted or rejected, and it ends. |
| [`aiAssist.beforeHunkInsert`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.beforeHunkInsert) | 5.4.0 | Once per AI change in a collaborative review in Suggesting mode. |
| [`dockPanel.opening`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#dockPanel.opening) | 5.4.0 | A registered side panel is about to show. |
| [`drop.beforeCleanup`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#drop.beforeCleanup), [`drop.afterCleanup`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#drop.afterCleanup) | 5.1.0 | Just before and just after dropped content is cleaned. |
| [`cell.replaced`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#cell.replaced) | 4.6.2 | A cell pasted from another table replaces a cell, once for each cell. |

[All events](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/)

## Integrations

Each framework wrapper follows the editor's version. These are the ones that changed most since version 3.

| Framework | Package | Works with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [React](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/react/) | `react-froala-wysiwyg` | React 0.14 to 19 |
| [Angular](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/angular/) | `angular-froala-wysiwyg` | Angular 19 and later |
| [Vue](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/vue-js-3/) | `vue-froala-wysiwyg` | Vue 3.2 and later |
| [Svelte](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/svelte/) | `svelte-froala-wysiwyg` | Svelte 5, new in 5.3.0 |

On the server, the [Node.js SDK](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/sdks/nodejs/) and the other [server SDKs](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/sdks/) handle uploads.

The editor ships its TypeScript types, `index.d.ts`, since 4.1.0.

## Why Upgrade

What versions 4 and 5 bring, by release. The [changelog](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/changelog/) lists every fix.

- Security fixes, among them cross-site scripting issues such as CVE-2023-41592 and CVE-2023-43263 (4.1.4 and 4.2.2).
- Real-time collaboration, with comments, suggestions and version history (5.3.0).
- AI Assist (5.1.0), then AI Chat, reviewable AI edits, suggestions as you type and dictation (5.4.0), and AI image generation (5.5.0), through the AI provider you connect.
- Headless mode for your own editor interface, with initial, limited feature support (5.5.0).
- Track Changes and Markdown (4.0.0), Word Counter (4.2.0), Filestack (4.3.0), Find and Replace (4.5.2), Anchor, Page Break and Export to Word (4.7.0), Code Snippet and Import from Word (5.0.0).
- Table and cell properties (4.6.0), draggable tables and copying cells (4.6.2), and separate horizontal and vertical resizing (5.0.1).
- TypeScript types in the package (4.1.0) and wrappers for current React, Vue, Angular and Svelte.
- `pluginsDisabled` to turn plugins off (4.5.0), YouTube Shorts links in the video plugin (4.2.2), and `toolbarBottom` on mobile devices (4.1.0).
- Fixes for accessibility, iPhone and iPad, and pasting from Word across the 4.x and 5.x releases.

## Release Posts

- [Froala 5.5, AI image generation and headless mode](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-v5-5-ai-image-generation-headless-mode/)
- [Froala 5.4, AI Chat, reviewable AI edits and Markdown](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-v5-4-ai-chat-markdown/)
- [Froala 5.3, real-time collaboration and Svelte](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/release-v5-3-1-real-time-collaboration/)
- [Froala 5.2, Filerobot and CSP work](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-editor-v5-2-filerobot-csp-compliance/)
- [Froala 5.1, the AI Assist plugin](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-5-1-release-ai-assist-plugin/)
- [Tables in version 5 compared with version 3](https://froala.com/blog/editor/still-using-froala-v3-stop-fighting-with-tables/)

## Get Help

Stuck on an upgrade, or want a hand with the new features? Our support engineers help with migrations.

- [Talk to an engineer](https://froala.com/contact/?department=Tech%20Support)
- [Migrate from V4 to V5](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/migrating-from-froala-4-to-froala-5/)

pages.title: Migrate from V4 to V5
pages.markdown:
# Migrate from V4 to V5

Version 5 keeps the version 4 API. No option, plugin or documented method of 4.x was removed, so upgrading is a new package, a new license key and a look at the few defaults that changed.

Version 5 needs a new license key. Ask [support@froala.com](mailto:support@froala.com) for yours.

## Install Version 5

Update the editor and your framework's wrapper together. Each wrapper depends on the exact editor version it was released with.

**React**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5 react-froala-wysiwyg@5
```

[React guide](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/react/)

**Vue**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5 vue-froala-wysiwyg@5
```

[Vue guide](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/vue-js-3/)

**Angular**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5 angular-froala-wysiwyg@5
```

[Angular guide](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/angular/)

**JavaScript**

```shell
npm install froala-editor@5
```

[Installation](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/overview/)

From the CDN, point your tags at version 5.

```html
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@5/css/froala_editor.pkgd.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@5/js/froala_editor.pkgd.min.js"></script>
```

No file of the 4.7.1 package was renamed or removed in 5.5.0, so your script and stylesheet paths stay the same.

`froala_editor.pkgd.min.js` grew from 1.3 MB in 4.7.1 to 2.0 MB in 5.5.0 (367 KB to 549 KB gzipped), most of it the Collaborative and AI Assist plugins. To load less, use `froala_editor.min.js` and only the [plugins](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/) you need.

## Add Your License Key

The editor starts the same way in both versions. Keep your options and events, and put the version 5 key in `key`.

```js
new FroalaEditor('#editor', {
  key: 'YOUR_V5_LICENSE_KEY',

  // Your version 4 options, unchanged.
  toolbarButtons: [['bold', 'italic', 'underline'], ['insertLink', 'insertImage']],

  events: {
    contentChanged: function () {
      // Inside a handler, this is the editor.
      console.log(this.html.get());
    }
  }
});
```

[Activation](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/activation/)

## Changed Defaults

These defaults changed during version 4 and version 5. If you are on an early 4.x release, check each one; an option you set yourself keeps your value.

| Option | Since | What changed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`fontSize`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSize) | 5.3.0 | The list ends with `'custom'`, which lets users type a size between `fontSizeCustomMin` and `fontSizeCustomMax`. |
| [`tableDefaultBorderStyle`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultBorderStyle), [`tableDefaultBorderWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultBorderWidth) | 5.0.0 | From `'solid'` and `'1px'` to `''`. |
| [`tableDefaultWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableDefaultWidth) | 4.6.0 | From `'100%'` to `'50%'`, so a new table fills half the width. |
| [`tableEditButtons`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableEditButtons) | 4.6.0 | `tableProperties` and `tableCellProperties` replace `tableStyle` and `tableCellBackground`. Since 4.0.19 the list also has `tableFooter`. |
| `imageInsertButtons`, `videoInsertButtons`, `fileInsertButtons`, `filesInsertButtons` | 4.3.0 | With the Filestack plugin loaded, as it is in `froala_editor.pkgd.min.js`, each insert popup shows a Filestack picker button. Set `pluginsDisabled: ['filestack']` to leave it out. |
| [`fontSizeDefaultSelection`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSizeDefaultSelection) | 4.2.1 | From `'12'` to `'Font Size'`. Set to a size, it is also applied to the content. |

One undocumented helper went away, `helpers.isOneNoteOnSafari`, added in 4.7.1 and removed in 5.0.0.

## New Plugins

Version 5 adds five plugins. All but Image Filerobot are in `froala_editor.pkgd.min.js`; to load them one by one, add each one's script and stylesheet.

| Plugin | Since | What it does | Name |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Collaborative](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/collaborative-plugin/) | 5.3.0 | Real-time editing, comments, suggestions and version history. | `collaborative` |
| [Image Filerobot](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/filerobot-image-editor-plugin/) | 5.2.0 | Edits images in Filerobot Image Editor. A third-party plugin in `js/third_party/imageFileRobot.min.js`, which needs the Filerobot library. | `imageFilerobot` |
| [AI Assist](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/ai-assist-plugin/) | 5.1.0 | AI writing and editing tools through the AI provider you connect. Needs `aiSupplementalTermsAccepted: true`. | `aiAssist` |
| [Code Snippet](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/code-snippet-plugin/) | 5.0.0 | Inserts code blocks with syntax highlighting. Needs Prism.js on the page. | `codeSnippet` |
| [Import from Word](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/import-from-word-plugin/) | 5.0.0 | Imports a Word (.docx) file, converted in the browser with Mammoth.js or on your server. | `importFromWord` |

If you set `pluginsEnabled`, add the names of the new plugins you want to it.

```js
new FroalaEditor('#editor', {
  pluginsEnabled: ['image', 'link', 'table', 'codeSnippet', 'importFromWord']
});
```

[Plugins](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/plugins/)

## New Options

Besides each new plugin's own options, these options were added or changed. Changed ones are marked.

| Option | Since | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`headless`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#headless) | 5.5.0 | Runs the editor without its toolbar, popups or other UI, so you build your own controls on its API. |
| [`preserveListMarkerStyle`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#preserveListMarkerStyle) | 5.5.0 | Where bold or italic on a whole list item goes. `true`, the default, styles the `li` and its marker; `false` wraps the text in `strong` or `em`. |
| [`collabConfig.panel.defaultState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#collabConfig.panel.defaultState) | 5.5.0 | The state the collaboration side panel opens in, `'expanded'` (the default), `'collapsed'` or `'hidden'`. |
| [`aiChatModels`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatModels) | 5.5.0, changed | A model that declares `webSearch: false` or `reasoning: false` turns off the matching AI Chat toggle. |
| [`aiChatWebSearchEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatWebSearchEnabled), [`aiChatReasoningEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatReasoningEnabled) | 5.5.0, changed | The toggle's starting state is now a request. It stays off for a model that declares the feature `false`. |
| [`aiAssistRequest`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiAssistRequest) | 5.5.0, changed | Your handler receives `regenerate: true` when the user clicks Try again, so a caching backend can send a fresh answer. Since 5.4.0 it can stream through a third argument, `onChunk`, and report `webSearchUsed`. |
| [`aiChatModels`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatModels) | 5.4.0 | The models users pick from in the AI Chat panel. |
| [`aiChatDefaultModel`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatDefaultModel) | 5.4.0 | The model selected when the panel opens. |
| [`aiChatWebSearchEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatWebSearchEnabled), [`aiChatReasoningEnabled`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatReasoningEnabled) | 5.4.0 | Whether the web search and reasoning toggles start on. |
| [`aiChatStreamResponse`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatStreamResponse) | 5.4.0 | Streams AI Chat answers, or waits for the whole answer. |
| [`aiChatSupportedFileTypes`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatSupportedFileTypes), [`aiChatMaxFileSizeMB`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatMaxFileSizeMB), [`aiChatMaxFiles`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatMaxFiles) | 5.4.0 | Which files users can attach as context, how large, and how many. |
| [`aiChatRequestTimeoutMs`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatRequestTimeoutMs) | 5.4.0 | How long to wait for an answer, in milliseconds. |
| [`aiChatIncludeReferenceUrlsInContext`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatIncludeReferenceUrlsInContext) | 5.4.0 | Whether reference URLs are also added to the prompt text. |
| [`aiChatPanelWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatPanelWidth), [`aiChatPanelMaxWidth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatPanelMaxWidth) | 5.4.0 | The panel's starting and largest width, in pixels. |
| [`aiChatWelcomeMessage`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiChatWelcomeMessage) | 5.4.0 | The intro text of the empty panel. |
| [`aiImproveWritingPrompt`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiImproveWritingPrompt) | 5.4.0 | The instruction sent each time Improve Writing runs. |
| [`selectionActionButtons`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#selectionActionButtons) | 5.4.0 | The buttons of the popup that opens on a text selection. |
| [`inlineSuggestions`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#inlineSuggestions), [`inlineSuggestionsDelay`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#inlineSuggestionsDelay), [`inlineSuggestionsPromptTemplate`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#inlineSuggestionsPromptTemplate) | 5.4.0 | Suggested text that continues what the user types, the wait before it is requested, and its prompt. |
| [`aiSpeechToText`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToText), [`aiSpeechToTextWaveform`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToTextWaveform), [`aiSpeechToTextListeningText`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToTextListeningText), [`aiSpeechToTextMaxDuration`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#aiSpeechToTextMaxDuration) | 5.4.0 | A microphone button to dictate the AI prompt, its waveform and label, and the longest recording, in seconds. |
| [`fontSizeCustomMin`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSizeCustomMin), [`fontSizeCustomMax`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#fontSizeCustomMax) | 5.3.0 | The smallest and largest size users can type in the custom font size box. |
| [`importFromWordMammoth`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#importFromWordMammoth) | 5.3.0 | The Mammoth instance Import from Word uses, for module builds such as Vite. |
| [`preserveListLineOnBackspace`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#preserveListLineOnBackspace) | 5.2.0 | Backspace at the start of a list item removes only its marker. |
| [`toolbarButtonsEnabledOnEditorOff`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#toolbarButtonsEnabledOnEditorOff) | 5.0.1 | The buttons that stay active after `edit.off()`, for a partly read-only editor. |
| [`tableHorizontalResizer`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableHorizontalResizer), [`tableVerticalResizer`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#tableVerticalResizer) | 5.0.1 | Turn horizontal and vertical table resizing on or off. |
| [`retainLineBreaksInCellsOnWrap`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/#retainLineBreaksInCellsOnWrap) | 5.0.0 | Keeps the line breaks in a table cell when its content wraps. |

The Since column on this page comes from comparing the packaged file of every release on npm, from 4.0.0 to 5.5.0.

[All options](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/)

## New Methods

Besides each new plugin's own methods, these methods were added or changed. Call them on the editor once it has started.

| Method | Since | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`helpers.isHeadless`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.isHeadless) | 5.5.0 | Whether the editor runs in headless mode. |
| [`helpers.isUserOpt`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.isUserOpt) | 5.5.0 | Whether you set an option yourself or it has its default. |
| [`helpers.headlessDefault`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.headlessDefault) | 5.5.0 | In headless mode, sets an option unless you set it yourself. |
| [`helpers.guardHeadlessUI`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.guardHeadlessUI) | 5.5.0 | In headless mode, turns a plugin's own UI methods into ones that do nothing. |
| [`helpers.ensureHeadlessFocus`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#helpers.ensureHeadlessFocus) | 5.5.0 | In headless mode, puts the caret in the content if the selection is elsewhere. |
| [`collaborative.getPanelState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.getPanelState), [`collaborative.setPanelState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.setPanelState) | 5.5.0 | Read and set the collaboration side panel's state, `'expanded'`, `'collapsed'` or `'hidden'`. They belong to the Collaborative plugin, not to `helpers`. |
| [`collaborative.updatePanelState`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.updatePanelState) | 5.5.0, changed | Expands or collapses the side panel. Added in 5.3.0. |
| `image.insertByURL` | 5.5.0, changed | Inserts the image from the URL in the insert popup. An older method; the change is not described on the Methods page. |
| [`aiAssist.requestAnswer`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiAssist.requestAnswer) | 5.4.0, changed in 5.5.0 | Sends one request to your AI backend and resolves with the whole answer. Its `params` take more optional fields since 5.5.0. |
| [`aiAssist.requestAnswerStream`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiAssist.requestAnswerStream) | 5.4.0 | The same request, streamed through an `onChunk` callback. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.togglePanel`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.togglePanel), [`aiChatAssistant.isPanelOpen`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.isPanelOpen) | 5.4.0 | Open or close the AI Chat panel, and check whether it is open. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.sendMessage`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.sendMessage) | 5.4.0 | Sends a prompt with the active context. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.addContextSource`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.addContextSource), [`aiChatAssistant.removeContextSource`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.removeContextSource) | 5.4.0 | Add and remove a context source of the conversation. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.hasActiveConversation`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.hasActiveConversation), [`aiChatAssistant.getChatHistory`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.getChatHistory) | 5.4.0 | Whether a conversation is open, and the whole conversation so far. |
| [`aiChatAssistant.applyToEditor`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiChatAssistant.applyToEditor) | 5.4.0 | Puts a chat answer into the document. |
| [`aiImproveWriting.start`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.start) | 5.4.0 | Sends the selection to the AI and opens the review of its changes. |
| [`aiImproveWriting.hasActiveSession`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.hasActiveSession), [`aiImproveWriting.hasActiveCollabReview`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.hasActiveCollabReview), [`aiImproveWriting.isInFlight`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.isInFlight) | 5.4.0 | Whether a review or a collaborative review is open, and whether a request is waiting for its answer. |
| [`aiImproveWriting.acceptAllSession`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.acceptAllSession), [`aiImproveWriting.rejectAllSession`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.rejectAllSession) | 5.4.0 | Accept or reject every change of the open review. |
| [`aiImproveWriting.applyExternalRewriteDirect`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#aiImproveWriting.applyExternalRewriteDirect) | 5.4.0 | Applies a rewrite made elsewhere, such as in AI Chat, with the same change review. |
| [`collaborative.isPanelOpen`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.isPanelOpen), [`collaborative.hidePanelForCoexistence`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#collaborative.hidePanelForCoexistence) | 5.4.0 | Whether the comments panel is open, and hide it so another side panel can open. |
| [`dockPanel.registerCoexistence`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#dockPanel.registerCoexistence), [`dockPanel.unregisterCoexistence`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#dockPanel.unregisterCoexistence) | 5.4.0 | Register your own side panel so only one side panel is open at a time, and remove it again. |
| [`markdown.getMarkdown`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#markdown.getMarkdown), [`markdown.setMarkdown`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#markdown.setMarkdown) | 5.4.0 | Read and replace the content as Markdown. |
| [`selection.element`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#selection.element) | 5.4.0, changed | Returns the element at the selection. An older method, which now takes an optional `skipCaptionNormalization` argument. |
| [`toast.show`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/#toast.show) | 5.3.0 | Shows a toast notification. |

[All methods](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/)

## New Events

Besides each new plugin's own events, these events were added or changed.

| Event | Since | When it fires |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`image.resizeStart`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#image.resizeStart) | 5.5.0 | The user grabs an image resize handle, before the size changes. |
| [`video.resizeStart`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#video.resizeStart), [`video.resizeEnd`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#video.resizeEnd) | 5.5.0 | The user grabs a video resize handle, and releases it with the new size applied. |
| [`collab.panelStateChanged`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#collab.panelStateChanged) | 5.5.0 | The collaboration side panel changes state. Passes the new state, the previous one and what caused it. |
| [`image.replaced`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#image.replaced) | 5.5.0, changed | Also passes the replaced image's `src`, as a third argument, `old_src`. |
| [`video.replaced`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#video.replaced) | 5.5.0, changed | Passes the upload response and the replaced video's `old_src`, for uploads and URLs alike. |
| [`markdown.beforeGet`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.beforeGet), [`markdown.afterGet`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.afterGet) | 5.4.0 | Before and after `markdown.getMarkdown()` reads the content. Returning `false` from the first cancels the read. |
| [`markdown.beforeSet`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.beforeSet), [`markdown.set`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#markdown.set) | 5.4.0 | Before and after `markdown.setMarkdown()` sets the content. Returning `false` from the first cancels it. |
| [`aiAssist.chatPanelResized`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.chatPanelResized) | 5.4.0 | The user finishes resizing the AI Chat panel. |
| [`aiAssist.chatBeforeApply`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.chatBeforeApply), [`aiAssist.chatAfterApply`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.chatAfterApply) | 5.4.0 | Before and after a chat answer goes into the document. Returning `false` from the first cancels it. |
| [`aiAssist.improveWritingStarted`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.improveWritingStarted), [`aiAssist.improveWritingResponse`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.improveWritingResponse) | 5.4.0 | An Improve Writing request is sent, and its answer arrives. |
| [`aiAssist.reviewStarted`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.reviewStarted), [`aiAssist.reviewEnded`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.reviewEnded) | 5.4.0 | A review of AI changes opens, and ends with every change resolved. |
| [`aiAssist.hunkResolved`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.hunkResolved) | 5.4.0 | One change of the review is accepted or rejected. |
| [`aiAssist.beforeHunkInsert`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#aiAssist.beforeHunkInsert) | 5.4.0 | Once per AI change in a collaborative review in Suggesting mode. |
| [`dockPanel.opening`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#dockPanel.opening) | 5.4.0 | A registered side panel is about to show. |
| [`drop.beforeCleanup`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#drop.beforeCleanup), [`drop.afterCleanup`](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/#drop.afterCleanup) | 5.1.0 | Just before and just after dropped content is cleaned. |

[All events](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/)

## Why Upgrade

What version 5 brings, by release. The [changelog](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/changelog/) lists every fix.

- Real-time collaboration, with comments, suggestions and version history (5.3.0).
- AI Assist (5.1.0), then AI Chat, reviewable AI edits, suggestions as you type and dictation (5.4.0), and AI image generation (5.5.0), through the AI provider you connect.
- Headless mode for your own editor interface, with initial, limited feature support (5.5.0).
- Code snippets and Import from Word (5.0.0), Filerobot image editing (5.2.0), and Markdown as the source format (5.4.0).
- Separate horizontal and vertical table resizing, and a partly read-only editor (5.0.1).
- A Svelte wrapper (5.3.0).
- Fixes for accessibility, iPhone and iPad, and pasting from Word across the 5.x releases.

## Release Posts

- [Froala 5.5, AI image generation and headless mode](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-v5-5-ai-image-generation-headless-mode/)
- [Froala 5.4, AI Chat, reviewable AI edits and Markdown](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-v5-4-ai-chat-markdown/)
- [Froala 5.3, real-time collaboration and Svelte](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/release-v5-3-1-real-time-collaboration/)
- [Froala 5.2, Filerobot and CSP work](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-editor-v5-2-filerobot-csp-compliance/)
- [Froala 5.1, the AI Assist plugin](https://froala.com/blog/editor/new-releases/froala-5-1-release-ai-assist-plugin/)
- [Tables in version 5](https://froala.com/blog/editor/still-using-froala-v3-stop-fighting-with-tables/)

## Get Help

Stuck on an upgrade, or want a hand with the new features? Our support engineers help with migrations.

- [Talk to an engineer](https://froala.com/contact/?department=Tech%20Support)
- [Migrate from V3 to V5](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/migrating-from-froala-3-to-froala-5/)

pages.title: Migrate from Trix
pages.markdown:
# Migrate from Trix

Trix is the rich text editor from 37signals that Rails Action Text uses. This guide replaces it with Froala in the same form and maps Trix's attributes, events and calls to Froala's.

## Initialization

| Task | Trix | Froala |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The editor | A `<trix-editor>` element, with its toolbar inserted before it | `new FroalaEditor()` on a `textarea` or any other element |
| Submit with a form | A hidden input named in the editor's `input` attribute | The `textarea` itself. The editor writes its HTML into it when the form is submitted. |
| Stored content | The hidden input's `value` | The `textarea`'s content |

### Remove Trix

Remove the Trix stylesheet and script, or the `trix` import and package, then replace the hidden input and the `<trix-editor>` with one `textarea` that carries the field's name and content.

```html
<!-- Remove -->
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="https://unpkg.com/trix@2.0.8/dist/trix.css">
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://unpkg.com/trix@2.0.8/dist/trix.umd.min.js"></script>

<form action="/articles" method="post">
  <input id="content" type="hidden" name="content" value="<p>Getting started</p>">
  <trix-editor input="content"></trix-editor>
</form>

<!-- Add -->
<form action="/articles" method="post">
  <textarea id="content" name="content"><p>Getting started</p></textarea>
</form>
```

```shell
npm uninstall trix
```

### Add Froala

Add the editor's stylesheet in the `head` and its script at the end of the `body`, then start it on the `textarea`. The editor draws its icons as SVG and needs neither Font Awesome nor jQuery.

```html
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@latest/css/froala_editor.pkgd.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@latest/js/froala_editor.pkgd.min.js"></script>
<script>
  var editor = new FroalaEditor('#content', { key: 'YOUR_LICENSE_KEY' });
</script>
```

With a bundler, install the package and import the same files.

```shell
npm install froala-editor
```

### Full Example

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Migrate from Trix to Froala</title>
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@latest/css/froala_editor.pkgd.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
  </head>
  <body>
    <form action="/articles" method="post">
      <textarea id="content" name="content"><p>Getting started</p></textarea>
      <button type="submit">Save</button>
    </form>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/froala-editor@latest/js/froala_editor.pkgd.min.js"></script>
    <script>
      var editor = new FroalaEditor('#content', {
        key: 'YOUR_LICENSE_KEY',
        placeholderText: 'Write something'
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

- [Save inside a form](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/concepts/save/inside-form/)
- [Activation](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/activation/)

## Map the API

Trix fires DOM events on the `<trix-editor>` element. Froala's events go in the `events` option, and inside a handler `this` is the editor, so write a regular function rather than an arrow function.

| Trix | Froala |
| --- | --- |
| The `placeholder` attribute | `placeholderText` |
| The `disabled` attribute or property | `editor.edit.off()` and `editor.edit.on()` |
| `trix-initialize` | The `initialized` event |
| `trix-change` | The `contentChanged` event |
| `trix-focus` and `trix-blur` | The `focus` and `blur` events |
| The hidden input's `value` | `editor.html.get()` |
| `element.editor.insertHTML(html)` | `editor.html.insert(html)` |
| The `trix-content` class on stored content you show | The `fr-view` class, with `froala_style.min.css` |

```js
// Trix
document.addEventListener('trix-change', function (event) {
  console.log(document.getElementById('content').value);
});

// Froala
var editor = new FroalaEditor('#content', {
  events: {
    contentChanged: function () {
      console.log(this.html.get());
    }
  }
});
```

- [Events](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/events/)
- [Methods](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/methods/)

## Attachments

Trix hands you each file in a `trix-attachment-add` event, and you upload it and set the attachment's URL yourself.

Froala uploads for you. Set `imageUploadURL` for images and `fileUploadURL` for other files; your server returns JSON with a `link` field. To refuse image uploads, as `preventDefault()` on `trix-file-accept` does, set `imageUpload` to `false`.

```js
// Trix
document.addEventListener('trix-attachment-add', function (event) {
  var attachment = event.attachment;
  if (attachment.file) uploadAndSetURL(attachment); // your own upload code
});

// Froala
var editor = new FroalaEditor('#content', {
  imageUploadURL: '/upload_image',
  fileUploadURL: '/upload_file'
});
```

[Image Upload](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/concepts/image/upload/)

## Rails Action Text

Action Text renders Trix for `form.rich_textarea`, saves the content in its own RichText model and stores attachments with Active Storage.

To use Froala, keep the HTML in a text column of your model, render `form.text_area` for it and start Froala on that field. The `wysiwyg-rails` gem packages the editor's files for the Rails asset pipeline.

```erb
<%# Trix, through Action Text %>
<%= form.rich_textarea :content %>

<%# Froala %>
<%= form.text_area :content, id: 'content' %>
```

With its default settings, Froala removes the `action-text-attachment` elements Action Text stores for attachments. Turn them into `img` or `a` elements before you move the content.

[Rails guide](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/framework-plugins/rails/)

## Match the Features

| Feature | In Froala |
| --- | --- |
| Editing in place | `toolbarInline: true`, and `toolbarVisibleWithoutSelection` to keep the toolbar next to the cursor |
| Images | The Image plugin. Users can drop or paste images, insert them by URL, resize them and add captions. |
| Custom formats | `inlineClasses` for selected text and `paragraphStyles` for paragraphs, each a class you define in your CSS with its label |

- [Feature matching](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/migration-guides/trix/feature-matching/)
- [All options](https://froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/docs/options/)
